description: Represents a business pitch with various attributes and sections.

business_case_id.description: Identifier of the business case this pitch is associated with, if applicable.
business_case_id.title: Business Case Id

business_model_summary.description: A concise summary of the business model being pitched.
examples: Our platform leverages AI to provide personalized recommendations to users.
business_model_summary.title: Business Model Summary

canvas_id.description: Identifier of the canvas this pitch is associated with.
canvas_id.title: Canvas Id

competitive_advantages.description: A list of competitive advantages that differentiate the business from its competitors.
competitive_advantages.title: Competitive Advantages

financial_analysis_section.description: A section providing a financial analysis of the business, if applicable.
examples: Our financial projections indicate a steady growth trajectory over the next five years.
financial_analysis_section.title: Financial Analysis Section

hook.description: A brief and compelling hook for the pitch.
examples: Revolutionizing the way we connect with our customers.
hook.title: Hook

project_id.description: Identifier of the project this pitch is associated with.
project_id.title: Project Id

risk_analysis.description: A list of potential risks associated with the business and strategies to mitigate them.
examples: Market volatility: Diversify product offerings to reduce dependency on a single market segment.
risk_analysis.title: Risk Analysis

storytelling_id.description: Identifier of the storytelling this pitch is associated with.
storytelling_id.title: Storytelling Id

swot_id.description: Identifier of the SWOT analysis this pitch is associated with.
swot_id.title: Swot Id

team_info_id.description: Identifier of the team information this pitch is associated with, if applicable.
team_info_id.title: Team Info Id

team_section.description: A section highlighting the team behind the business, if applicable.
examples: Our team consists of experienced professionals with a proven track record in the industry.
team_section.title: Team Section

title: Pitch
